cohort: The study included 200 singleton pregnancies beyond 34 weeks gestation complicated by oligohydramnios at BebeNanki Mother and Child Care Centre, Amritsar.
finding: Severe oligohydramnios (AFI 0-2 cm) was significantly associated with a higher incidence of fetal growth restriction, low Apgar scores, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: A high cesarean section rate (71.5%) was observed, predominantly due to fetal distress.
